Site.reasoning: These are site codes representing the specific geographic locations where sampling occurred.

Year planted.reasoning: This header describes a specific characteristic (planting year) of the sample/site.

2013.reasoning: This header represents a temporal measurement (presence/absence) for the year 2013.

2014.reasoning: This header represents a temporal measurement (presence/absence) for the year 2014.

2015.reasoning: This header represents a temporal measurement (presence/absence) for the year 2015.

Age range.reasoning: This header describes a biological characteristic (age) measured for the organism.
